title: Successor retrieval omits root, mirror, and install-guide documentation
evidence: [INFERENCE: requested root and mirror documents are outside both declared root sets]

title: Workflow names a missing canonical memory-save content router
evidence: [INFERENCE: bounded source inventory found no runtime/handlers/memory-save.ts or content-router import]

title: Save completion does not prove the trigger index represents the current corpus
